english: simple English, sentence by sentence, after the whole katha
hindi: standard Hindi spelling; Bihari ya/ja and va/ba corrected
scripture: The firefly, the vision of the boys as Krishna, Vrindavan without enmity, and Brahma's praise are Srimad-Bhagavatam, Tenth Canto, as Maharaj told them, without verse numbers he did not lock. Jiva is named on the dative. Uddhava is named on the ornament. The Ramcharitmanas is named for the auspiciousness in the womb. The sitting ends on the aarti of the Bhagavatam. This is the last existing part.
